title: Add goal prompt context tests
objective: Define how an active goal appears in model context without changing normal prompts.
context: Codex docs say the goal text is the task target and completion criteria.
The model should see active goal context early in each turn, but completed or cleared goals should not keep steering it.

source_evidence.note: providerParams prepends UserContext before provider calls.

include: Test active goal is injected as a concise system-reminder style user context.
Test budget and last evaluator reason can be included when present.
Test absent, achieved, blocked, or cleared goal does not alter prompt context.
Test no-goal provider request remains unchanged.
exclude: Do not implement prompt or loop changes.

implementation_steps: Add prompt-level tests for goal context formatting.
Add loop-level tests that providerParams receives goal context only when active.
Keep expected text concise and stable.
deliverables: Failing prompt and loop tests for active goal context injection.
acceptance_criteria: Tests separate formatting from loop wiring.
No provider network calls are used.
risks: Putting goal text in the base system prompt would create broad snapshot churn.
dispatch_prompt: Add failing tests for active goal prompt context injection. Verify active-only behavior and no change when no goal is present. Do not implement production code.
notes_for_assignee: Prefer a user-context system reminder over modifying the base system prompt.
